text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — PROD us-east-1d: EBS detach rate > 10/min, ELB targetgroup `inference-gateway` reporting high unhealthy count, frontend 5xx spike ~35% in last 5m. Paging oncall @alice. Runbook: /runbooks/az-ebs-detach
Alice Romero: I'm on it — looking at ELB and instance events. Seeing a sequence of `AttachVolume`/`DetachVolume` errors + ENI churn in azd. Marking impact and paging SRE ops.
Mike Chen: I can help with cross-region work. Has anyone validated the Route53 weight-based failover for this service recently?
Alice Romero: Quick snapshot: ELB targetgroup `inference-gateway` healthy=12 unhealthy=28. CloudTrail shows repeating `AttachVolumeFailed` with error `volume-in-use` then detach storms. Beginning mitigation: reduce traffic to us-east-1 while we stabilize.
Priya Nair: If we shift traffic, can we warm more capacity in us-east-2? We have reserved nodes there; need canary traffic then scale.
Alice Romero: Initiating controlled Route53 weight change — target prod.example.com: us-east-1 -> 40, us-east-2 -> 60. @deploy-bot please apply DNS weight change (TTL 60).
deploy-bot: DNS change requested by Alice Romero: prod.example.com weights -> us-east-1=40, us-east-2=60. Applying... done. Propagation ~ TTL 60s. :white_check_mark:
Mike Chen: While DNS converges, I'm increasing ELB healthcheck timeout to 10s and lowering healthy threshold to 2 to reduce flapping for borderline hosts. Also will add a temporary NLB sticky rule to avoid rapid reconnect churn.
Lina Patel: Support update: ~12 premium customers reporting 5xx on inference endpoints. Status page updated and CS notified. Creating tickets and prioritizing customers affected by azd.
John Vargas: Collecting artifacts for timeline: ELB access logs, EC2 instance status events, EBS API errors + CloudTrail. I'll aggregate to the incident doc.
Alice Romero: After weight shift error rate down from 35% -> ~7% over last 6m. Continuing to drain and cordon affected instances in azd; will attempt controlled reattach of volumes after instance reboots.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-314 (P1) — channel incident response activated. Next handoff scheduled at 16:45 UTC.
Mike Chen: I will take lead on the mitigation after handoff. Plan: 1) keep Route53 weights shifted until stable 2) reprovision stuck EBS attachments with conservative backoff + retry 3) run canary requests from us-east-2 and EU to validate quality 4) run a rollout-only rollback if we see regressions.
Priya Nair: Also coordinate with infra to validate AZ-level control plane throttling or maintenance events — check AWS health dashboard and internal cloud provider alerts.
Alice Romero: Handing off operational lead to Mike (leaving notes in /wiki/incidents/INC-2026-314). Key items in doc: observed attach/detach loop, list of drained instance IDs, DNS weight history, initial customer impact list. :heavy_check_mark:
Mike Chen: ack handoff. Updating public status page and internal incident channel. Will post RCA outline once we verify root cause (suspect EBS attach storm after instance/eni resync bug).
Lina Patel: Noted — support has prioritized contacting top-affected customers and offering temporary guidance (retry/backoff).
John Vargas: Logging note: captured sample ELB 5xx responses and instance logs (attached in incident doc). Will add timeline entries for each mitigation step.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow runbook steps for AZ instability and schedule post-incident review within 72h.
Mike Chen: Current status: traffic shifted, error rate stabilized ~5-8%, continuing reprovision attempts. Will update every 15m or on major change.
Alice Romero: Thanks all — will stand by for followups.
